column1: # §4.7 — control-panel line 3 renders a `[████░░] N%` bar for ops
# whose loader can report progress (CSV byte counts, import row
# counts). For ops backed by an opaque IronCalc call (xlsx load /
# save / recalc) the verb-only line is shown — covered by the
# other M4_wait_* transcripts. This transcript pins the bar shape
# and the percentage rounding by seeding synthetic done/total.
# /FIN <path><Enter> queues a CSV import. The worker normally
# fills in done/total automatically; here we drive them ourselves
# 0% — no fill cells, all empty cells. The leading "Importing
# 25% — five filled cells out of twenty.
